name: mcpResourceLink
description: Builds a resource-link MCP content block. A resource link points at addressable content the model can read, without embedding the content itself. The uri identifies the resource; name, description, and mimeType are optional metadata. Omitted optional fields are left out rather than written as null. The block passes through the automatic result coercion untouched.

params.name: uri
params.description: The URI of the resource the link points to, e.g. "doc://pages/intro".

params.name: name
params.description: A human-readable name for the resource.

params.name: description
params.description: A human-readable description of the resource.

params.name: mimeType
params.description: The MIME type of the resource, e.g. "text/markdown".

links.title: RustCFML MCP documentation
links.description: Content helpers for exact control over MCP responses.

examples.title: Link to a resource from a tool response
examples.description: Return a text block plus a resource link in a single content list.
